arStrings.szText:
"Honored General,
With respect, I deny all accusations of cruelty in my training. Must not each warrior be pressed, as I was, to her limit to become Amazon?
Veneer of respect over defiance. Adamant.

To shy from those limits is to permit weakness, dulling our spears for the battle against pirates, drowned, and foreign agitators who threaten our way of life. We must not threaten it from within." -Captain Igata
Veneer of respect over defiance. Adamant.
